title: coord.py reads operator key files whatever their mode, so a world-readable token file goes unnoticed
goal: coord.py's client refuses a --key-file, and serve refuses a --keys directory file, that has group or other permission bits, with exit 2 and a line naming the file and mode 0600, as gate g1 records, and kb/_self/tools.md says to create a key file with mode 0600. Found by the SP-rsmmwzr2 review (G8): serve reads every file in --keys DIR and the client reads --key-file with no mode check.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
k=os.path.join(D,'k');open(k,'w').write('k'*40);os.chmod(k,0o644)
r,_,e=c('--url','http://127.0.0.1:1','--key-file',k,'list')
low=e.lower();ok=('0600' in e or 'mode' in low or 'permission' in low)
print('client names the 0644 key file mode:',ok,e.strip()[:160]);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
T='_tools/coord.py';D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'));E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
def run(a,t=30):
    try:
        p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stderr
    except s.TimeoutExpired as e:
        return None,(e.stderr.decode() if isinstance(e.stderr,bytes) else (e.stderr or ''))
said=lambda e:any(w in e.lower() for w in ('0600','mode','permission'))
k=os.path.join(D,'k');open(k,'w').write('k'*40);os.chmod(k,0o644)
c1=run(['--url','http://127.0.0.1:1','--key-file',k,'list'])
os.chmod(k,0o600);c2=run(['--url','http://127.0.0.1:1','--key-file',k,'list'])
K=os.path.join(D,'keys');os.mkdir(K);f=os.path.join(K,'alice');open(f,'w').write('a'*40);os.chmod(f,0o644)
c3=run(['serve','--bind','127.0.0.1:0','--keys',K],t=5)
ok=c1[0]==2 and said(c1[1]) and not said(c2[1]) and c3[0]==2 and said(c3[1])
print('client 0644',c1[0],'client 0600',c2[0],'serve 0644',c3[0],ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
